Java is \x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
a popular, high-level, object-oriented programming language and software platform\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> released by Sun Microsystems in 1995. It is best known for its "write once, run anywhere" (WORA) capability, allowing developers to create applications that can run on any device with a Java Virtual Machine (JVM). 
\x3C!--Sv6Kpe["be90d0f5-ee4d-43cf-9c4d-91827bb47492",{"elYHVd":null}]-->
\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[[null,null,"be90d0f5-ee4d-43cf-9c4d-91827bb47492",null,null,1,0]]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->

\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
How Java works 
\x3C!--Sv6Kpe["bcf16dde-0dca-4f1d-ac73-7504a475423e",{"elYHVd":null}]-->
\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[[null,null,"bcf16dde-0dca-4f1d-ac73-7504a475423e",null,null,0,0]]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
Instead of compiling directly into machine-readable code for a specific processor, Java works in two stages to achieve its platform independence. 
\x3C!--Sv6Kpe["b42adc95-f8bb-4f50-9a75-655bf2ee3f9f",{"elYHVd":null}]-->
\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[[null,null,"b42adc95-f8bb-4f50-9a75-655bf2ee3f9f",null,null,1,0]]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[["b42adc95-f8bb-4f50-9a75-655bf2ee3f9f","1",0,"https://azure.microsoft.com/en-in/resources/cloud-computing-dictionary/what-is-java-programming-language","https://encrypted-tbn2.gstatic.com/faviconV2?url\\u003dhttps://azure.microsoft.com\\u0026client\\u003dAIM\\u0026size\\u003d128\\u0026type\\u003dFAVICON\\u0026fallback_opts\\u003dTYPE,SIZE,URL"]]-->
  1. Compilation:\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> A Java program is first written in a text file and compiled by a Java compiler (javac\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->) into a platform-neutral intermediate code called bytecode\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->.\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
  2. Execution:\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> The bytecode is then executed by the Java Virtual Machine (JVM)\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->, which interprets or compiles it into the native machine code for the specific hardware and operating system it's running on.\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> 
    \x3C!--Sv6Kpe["7e3d414c-da86-4357-9f75-cc48c392eabf",{"elYHVd":null}]-->
    \x3C!--Sv6Kpe[[null,null,"7e3d414c-da86-4357-9f75-cc48c392eabf",null,null,1,0]]-->    \x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
    3. \x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->

\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[["7e3d414c-da86-4357-9f75-cc48c392eabf","3",0,"https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/java/introduction-to-java/","https://encrypted-tbn1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?url\\u003dhttps://www.geeksforgeeks.org\\u0026client\\u003dAIM\\u0026size\\u003d128\\u0026type\\u003dFAVICON\\u0026fallback_opts\\u003dTYPE,SIZE,URL"]]-->
\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
Key features 
\x3C!--Sv6Kpe["ffda8795-cc88-4bbb-ab3d-3f0ab5d04ed5",{"elYHVd":null}]-->
\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[[null,null,"ffda8795-cc88-4bbb-ab3d-3f0ab5d04ed5",null,null,0,0]]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
  • Object-Oriented:\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> Java organizes code around objects and classes, making it modular, reusable, and easier to maintain.\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
  • Platform-Independent:\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> The WORA principle ensures that Java applications can run on any device with a JVM, whether it's running Windows, macOS, or Linux.\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
  • Robust and Secure:\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> Java includes features like automatic memory management (garbage collection), strong typing, and built-in security to protect against viruses and malicious code.\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
  • Multithreaded:\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> Java supports multithreading, allowing a program to perform multiple tasks simultaneously, which improves performance for interactive and network-based applications.\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
  • Rich API and Libraries:\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> Java comes with a vast collection of pre-written libraries and APIs that provide extensive functionality for everything from networking and database access to graphics and security.\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> 
    \x3C!--Sv6Kpe["e9a3bc28-4d55-4d86-81cb-8f0d3f5d8319",{"elYHVd":null}]-->

\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
What is Java used for? 
\x3C!--Sv6Kpe["a5bbd7cf-722f-472b-a8db-5bd247723dbb",{"elYHVd":null}]-->
\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[[null,null,"a5bbd7cf-722f-472b-a8db-5bd247723dbb",null,null,0,0]]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
Java is a versatile language that powers a wide range of applications and systems. 
\x3C!--Sv6Kpe["6c606105-6382-49e6-9681-a01109f3a3b1",{"elYHVd":null}]-->
\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[[null,null,"6c606105-6382-49e6-9681-a01109f3a3b1",null,null,1,0]]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[["6c606105-6382-49e6-9681-a01109f3a3b1","1",0,"https://azure.microsoft.com/en-in/resources/cloud-computing-dictionary/what-is-java-programming-language","https://encrypted-tbn2.gstatic.com/faviconV2?url\\u003dhttps://azure.microsoft.com\\u0026client\\u003dAIM\\u0026size\\u003d128\\u0026type\\u003dFAVICON\\u0026fallback_opts\\u003dTYPE,SIZE,URL"]]-->
  • Android Mobile Apps:\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> The Android operating system is based on Java, and many Android apps are built using it.\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
  • Enterprise Software:\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> Java's security, stability, and scalability make it the language of choice for large, distributed enterprise systems, such as those used by banks and major corporations.\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
  • Web Applications:\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> Java is used for server-side web development using frameworks like Spring Boot.\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
  • Cloud Computing:\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> Its platform independence makes Java well-suited for cloud-based applications that need to run on various platforms.\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
  • Big Data:\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> Java is used in big data technologies, such as Apache Hadoop and Kafka, for processing large datasets.\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
  • Gaming:\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> Popular games, including Minecraft\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->, are built with Java.\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
  • Internet of Things (IoT):\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]--> Java is a popular choice for programming sensors and devices in the IoT ecosystem.\x3C!--Sv6Kpe[]-->
